<thought>Only the carbon isotopic pattern (M, M+1, M+2, etc.) matches the observed series with ~1 Da spacing and relative intensities consistent with the natural 13C abundance. No other element shows a characteristic pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S) in this spectrum, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
